$comment: Validator check 7 (spec 9.4): the only phrases a story may use to state a subject's role. Each maps to one actor_role; basis_prefixes, when present, limit the phrase to subjects whose role_basis starts with one of them. unknown has no phrase. Matching is case-insensitive on whole words.

phrases.phrase: someone who came out of the house
someone who arrived from outside the property
